summary.text: Adrian Fisher is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 16, which covers Morehouse and Ouachita parishes, and was first elected in 2021. The House's member page lists Fisher's committees as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development; Appropriations; and Health and Welfare, and as treasurer of the Democratic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: According to the Louisiana House member page, Adrian Fisher is a business owner at Cognitive Development Centers.
The page lists a bachelor's degree in accounting from Southern University and A&M College and a master's degree in community counseling from the University of Louisiana Monroe.
It lists caucus affiliations with the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Louisiana Rural Caucus, in addition to the Democratic Caucus.
